what: a plate with 6 pockets made by patterning one pocket and the R3.2 round of its four corner edges, the pocket height set by a parameter
method: plate 150 x 422.275 x 19.05; each pocket 143.65 x h x 12.7 deep with h = (419.1 - 3.175 - 5*3.175)/6 = 66.6750 mm, its four vertical corner edges (concave) rounded R3.2: the rounds add (1-pi/4) 3.2^2 x 4 = (4-pi) 3.2^2 of area back, so the pocket area is 143.65 h - (4-pi) 3.2^2 = 9569.074. V = 150*422.275*19.05 - 6 * 12.7 * pocket = 477487.40. Pockets are 3.175 apart.
